chunks: So, I call to witness what you see

key_terms.أُقْسِمُ: I swear / I call to witness
key_terms.تُبْصِرُونَ: You see / You perceive with sight

ai.seo_question: What does God swear by in Surah Al-Haqqa to prove the certainty of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Haqqa, this verse employs an oath by visible phenomena to anchor the abstract concept of the Resurrection in tangible reality, a rhetorical device often highlighted by Shia exegetes to demonstrate the logical progression from the known to the unknown. It underscores the certainty of divine judgment, serving as a prelude to the detailed descriptions of the fates of the righteous and the wicked, thereby reinforcing the theme of inevitable accountability.
